mod.toolmastery.name: Tool Mastery
screen.toolmastery.title: Tool Mastery
screen.toolmastery.tier_locked: Tier locked — complete the gate first
screen.toolmastery.help: Click a node to see its details and buy it with XP levels. Click a tier header (T1-T5) to see its gate achievements and unlock it.
node.toolmastery.masons_grip.desc: Passive: mine stone, deepslate and ores faster with a pickaxe. I: +10%. II: +20%. III: +30%.
node.toolmastery.miners_magnet.desc: Passive: drops from blocks broken with a pickaxe go straight into your inventory — including the extras from Dig Range and Rich Vein, and what Melt already smelted. Whatever does not fit is left on the ground.
node.toolmastery.melt.desc: Enchantment: chance to smelt ore drops on the spot. I: 25%. II: 50%. III: 100%. Applied to your held pickaxe on purchase; also available via /enchant.
node.toolmastery.dig_range.desc: Enchantment: break extra blocks. I: the block below. II: a cross on the facing plane. III: full 3x3. Sneak to disable. Applied to your held pickaxe on purchase.
node.toolmastery.prospectors_sense.desc: Active: nearby ores glow through stone for a few seconds. (Coming online in a later update.)
node.toolmastery.miners_helm.desc: Unlocks the recipe for a helmet that grants night vision deep underground. (Coming online in a later update.)
node.toolmastery.rich_vein.desc: Enchantment: vein miner — breaking an ore breaks connected ores of the same type. I: up to 8. II: up to 16. Sneak to disable. Applied to your held pickaxe on purchase.
node.toolmastery.deep_haste.desc: Passive: permanent Haste I while you are below Y = 0. Never overrides a stronger Haste from a beacon or a potion.
node.toolmastery.obsidian_breaker.desc: Passive: obsidian and crying obsidian break 50% faster with a pickaxe.
node.toolmastery.magma_touch.desc: Capstone enchantment: everything you mine drops pre-smelted — ingots, glass, stone, bricks. Exclusive with Ancient Fortune.
node.toolmastery.ancient_fortune.desc: Capstone: +1 effective Fortune level on your pickaxe. Exclusive with Magma Touch. (Coming online in a later update.)
node.toolmastery.lumberjacks_arms.desc: Chop wood faster. (Passive; coming online in a later update.)
node.toolmastery.loggers_magnet.desc: Blocks chopped with an axe drop straight into your inventory. (Coming online in a later update.)
node.toolmastery.fair_harvest.desc: +25% sapling drop chance from leaves. (Coming online in a later update.)
node.toolmastery.logic.desc: Enchantment: breaking one log fells the whole tree (needs leaves — houses are safe). I: slow cascade. II: instant. III: clears the leaves too. Sneak to disable. Applied to your held axe on purchase.
node.toolmastery.rich_bark.desc: Stripping logs drops Bark — a light fuel and compostable item. (Coming online in a later update.)
node.toolmastery.pruner.desc: Leaves broken with an axe drop double loot. (Coming online in a later update.)
node.toolmastery.double_axe.desc: Chance for logs to drop double. I: 10%. II: 20%. (Coming online in a later update.)
node.toolmastery.shield_breaker.desc: Axes disable shields longer and hit shielded targets harder. (Coming online in a later update.)
node.toolmastery.call_of_the_forest.desc: Active: bone-meal effect in a 5x5 area. (Coming online in a later update.)
node.toolmastery.environment.desc: Enchantment: trees felled with Logic III replant their sapling on the stump, consuming one from your inventory. Applied to your held axe on purchase.
node.toolmastery.lumberjacks_fury.desc: Capstone: for 10s, Logic reaches every tree around you and chops twice as fast. Exclusive with Green Heart. (Coming online in a later update.)
node.toolmastery.green_heart.desc: Capstone: replanted saplings may grow instantly; Pruner gains Fortune. Exclusive with Lumberjack's Fury. (Coming online in a later update.)
